channel.name: NOMBER Devlog
channel.description_html:
An independent developer's journal featuring updates on my projects, open-source tools, new releases, experiments, and everything happening behind the scenes.

Built with curiosity, creativity, and a little help from AI.

posts.text_html:
One of the first projects I want to introduce here is DownGrab.

The idea behind it was simple: make downloading videos and audio as easy as sending a message on Telegram.

No need to search for third-party websites, install extra software, or deal with complicated interfaces.

Just send a link to @DownGrabBot, and the bot will process it and deliver the file directly to your chat.

A simple idea that grew into a much bigger project.

More about its development, features, and updates soon!
